text: A tight springy TWANG from the vibrating string of a medieval archery bow as one arrow is released. One clear pitched bowstring pluck with a short woody resonance. Dry close-up foley. No air whoosh.
Bow and arrow firing. A single traditional archery bowstring released from full draw: sharp string snap and unmistakable vibrating twang. One isolated archery shot.
One deep muffled thump: a heavy padded mallet striking a dense solid wooden block. Low-pitched, dull, weighty physical impact, short and dry. No ringing.
One powerful body punch. A low solid thud with a sharp impact onset and a very short bassy decay. Dense dry blunt-force combat hit, no metallic or musical tone.
